verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents per-user API keys and a request audit log in the self-hosted bundle, plus entity-scoped memory (user/agent/app/session) that could support basic access separation, but there is no evidence of role-based access control, granular permission policies, or ACLs governing who can read/write specific memories. missing for 10: RBAC/permission policies, ACL enforcement on read/write, admin console for managing roles, independent verification of audit log completeness.
